payload.observation: At 04:00 UTC weekday boundary, 3 cron expressions overlap for the same agent_ids:
payload.impact: Wasteful spawns — same agent runs 2-3x at boundary ticks. Internal dedup gates mitigate signal duplication but consume tokens. R3 (allow multi-fire) means dispatcher cannot deduplicate.
recommendation_options: A. Add exclusion logic to cron expressions (e.g., offhours = `0 */4 * * 0,6` for weekends-only, market = `*/15 2-8 * * 1-5` unchanged)
B. Add mutual-exclusion field to cowork-schedule.json (e.g., `priority` — lower-priority slot skips when higher fires) — requires matcher script update
C. Accept overlap as-is — agents already dedupe; token cost acceptable. Document in brief §5 R3 as expected behavior.
